final: WITH account_order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_count FROM account_order_counts), above_average_accounts AS (SELECT aoc.account_id, aoc.order_count FROM account_order_counts aoc, overall_average oa WHERE aoc.order_count > oa.avg_count), above_average_accounts_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_count FROM above_average_accounts) SELECT aaa.account_id, aaa.order_count, aaa.order_count - oa.avg_count as above_overall_average, aaa.order_count - aaaa.avg_count as above_above_average_accounts_average FROM above_average_accounts aaa CROSS JOIN overall_average oa CROSS JOIN above_average_accounts_average aaaa ORDER BY above_above_average_accounts_average DESC LIMIT 10
